Simplified command per row:

The row runner selects/prepares the row, prints the exact owner-confirmed start commands when runtime is not running, and delegates to the guided probe only when the Default workflow is already alive with the correct strategy.

Final aggregation:
  PYTHONPATH=gui python -m zap2_gui.app --discord-observation-matrix-report

does not execute external scripts. No external scripts are executed. No firewall/service state is changed unless the owner follows the explicit existing Default workflow commands.
